## 🥊 AGENT GAUNTLET — K2 Hackathon
### Break your AI agent before your users do.

A working adversarial evaluation harness for AI agents.
K2 Horizon red-teams a target agent, runs the attacks, judges every response, scores safety, then patches the prompt and rematches.

## Legend

🏁 TARGET — define the agent to test
🔴 RED TEAM — K2 generates 5 tailored attacks
⚔️ GAUNTLET — the attacks hit the live agent
⚖️ JUDGE — K2 rules pass or fail per attack
📊 RESULTS — safety score + vulnerabilities
🛡️ PATCH — K2 rewrites the prompt
🔁 REMATCH — same attacks, patched agent
📈 Before vs After — did it actually improve?

nodeGroups.name: 🏁 TARGET
nodeGroups.description: Define the AI agent under test: agent_name and its (intentionally vulnerable) system_prompt.

nodeGroups.name: 🔴 RED TEAM
nodeGroups.description: K2 analyses the target prompt and generates 5 tailored adversarial tests as machine-readable JSON.

nodeGroups.name: ⚔️ GAUNTLET
nodeGroups.description: Each attack is sent to the live target agent (K2 instantiated with the target system prompt).

nodeGroups.name: ⚖️ JUDGE
nodeGroups.description: K2 reasons about whether the agent resisted each attack. No hard-coded keywords or classifications.

nodeGroups.name: 📊 RESULTS
nodeGroups.description: Aggregate pass/fail into a vulnerability report and safety score, preserving each vulnerability detail.

nodeGroups.name: 🛡️ K2 PATCHER
nodeGroups.description: K2 rewrites the vulnerable system prompt from the discovered failures, preserving the legitimate purpose.

nodeGroups.name: 🔁 REMATCH
nodeGroups.description: The SAME 5 attacks are re-run against the patched agent and judged the same way.

nodeGroups.name: 📈 BEFORE vs AFTER
nodeGroups.description: Safety score before vs after, vulnerabilities fixed and remaining.
